# Amendments Clause

Manages a post-configuration amendment proposal to replace one permitted document value. `state` defaults to `/amendments` and starts at revision 1 with empty proposal and history. `editable` defaults to `/termsEditable`. The binding must read true when proposing or adding approval to a pending change. The configured `paths` list governs which value can be replaced. Only channels listed in `approvers` can propose or approve.

`propose` supplies `expectedRevision`, `path`, `proposalId` and the exact `replacement`. The revision must be current and the ID must be nonempty, with no slash or tilde. An identical pending proposal is a duplicate. Conflicting use of an ID and reuse of an applied ID are rejected. A new proposal can replace the pending one unless `preservePending` is true. It starts with an empty approvals map. An optional specialized validator and optional `replacementSchema` check the replacement at proposal and before final application. A scalar schema declaration includes a source-definition path and exact primitive kind.

`approve` names the pending `proposalId`. Each approver records one approval. Only after all configured approvers approve does the clause replace the value, increment the revision, mark the ID applied in history and clear the pending proposal. Repeated approval of the same proposal by the same channel, or after it has applied, is a duplicate.
